title: Vendor composite references `dcfg_vendor.address1_city_state_zip` â€” not a standard Dataverse column
detail: Lines 65-73 and 74-75: paths `dcfg_vendor.address1_line1` and `dcfg_vendor.address1_city_state_zip`. The `address1_line1` pattern is standard Dataverse composite-address field naming (same as contact/account). But `address1_city_state_zip` is NOT a standard composite â€” Dataverse composites are typically `address1_composite` (full block) or separate `address1_city`, `address1_stateorprovince`, `address1_postalcode`. The path as written will resolve to undefined. Templates mapping 'Vendor city, state, zip' produce blanks.
evidence: fieldRegistry.js:65-75. Dataverse standard address fields are address1_line1, address1_line2, address1_city, address1_stateorprovince, address1_postalcode, address1_composite.
recommendedFix: Either: (a) change the path to `dcfg_vendor.address1_composite` and accept the full address block format, (b) concatenate `address1_city + ', ' + address1_stateorprovince + ' ' + address1_postalcode` in the DocGen flow (server-side), or (c) add a calculated field `dcfg_vendor_city_state_zip` to the vendor table.
